common.sampleData: Sample data. All people, jobs and payments are fictional.

welcome.tagline: Real client work for young Nepalis, signed off by Nepalis abroad.
welcome.how1: A Nepali professional abroad (a Team Leader) brings client work to their team in Nepal.
welcome.how2: Young Nepalis do the work. The Leader checks it before the client sees it.
welcome.how3: Every finished job is added to a verified Work Record, and trust grows badge by badge.
welcome.samplesHelp: Demo people, one tap each. Password for all: kaam-demo

auth.name: Your name
auth.demoPassword: Demo accounts use the password kaam-demo.
auth.roleHelp_junior: You do client work in a team led by a Leader and build a signed Work Record.
auth.roleHelp_anchor: You lead a team in Nepal, bring clients and check work before it goes out.
auth.roleHelp_client: You post jobs. If a Leader invited you, enter their invite code.
auth.inviteHelp: From the Leader who invited you. Leave empty if you don't have one.
auth.emailTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in instead.
auth.badInvite: That invite code doesn't work or was already used.

levelScreen.help: Badges go up by themselves when the rules are met. You can lower a badge or pause one promotion, always with a reason the member sees.
levelScreen.means2: Does the work; the Leader checks everything.
levelScreen.means3: Does the work; the Leader checks some of it.
levelScreen.means4: Ready to work with clients directly.
levelScreen.lowerHelp: Only for a real problem, like copied work or a broken promise to a client.
levelScreen.lowerEx: Copied a template without telling the client.
levelScreen.pauseHelp: Once. After that, their next verified job counts again.
levelScreen.pauseEx: Let's see one more on-time job after the late delivery.
levelScreen.topBadge: This member has the top badge.

check.title: Quick check
check.anchorDecides: This check only helps. Your Leader decides.
check.link_unsupported: This link can't be read automatically. Only the pasted text and note were checked.
check.link_unreadable: The link couldn't be opened (is it public?). Only the pasted text and note were checked.

job.splitNote: Demo payment: the client pays after agreeing, it's held until they accept the work, then shared like this. No real money moves.
job.assignTitle: Give it to a team member
job.assignHelp: Their badge is recorded with the job.
job.submitHelp: A quick check runs straight away so you can fix things before your Leader looks.
job.linkHelp: A public GitHub pull request or a Google Doc shared with “anyone with the link” is read automatically.
job.paste: Or paste the text or code
job.pasteHelp: Only paste work for this job.
job.acceptedDone: Accepted and added to the Work Record as a verified job. Thank you.
job.clientWait_open: Waiting for Team Leaders or Mentors with this skill to apply.
job.clientWait_draft: {{name}} is updating the agreement with your changes.
job.clientWait_with_anchor: Waiting for {{name}} to agree to it.
job.clientWait_agreed: Agreed. {{name}} is choosing who does it.
job.clientWait_assigned: {{name}} offered it to a team member.
job.clientWait_working: The team is working on it.
job.clientWait_sent_back: {{name}} asked for changes before you see it.
job.showName: Show our business name and the work link in the member's public Work Record
job.showNameHelp: Off: the Work Record says “a client in your country”. The price is never shown.
job.splitPending: The member's share depends on their badge: from 50% (★ Starter) to 80% (★★★★★ Mentor). Sajha Kaam takes 15%; the rest goes to the Leader who checks the work.

desk.title: Today
desk.toCheckHelp: Oldest first, so nobody waits too long.
desk.toAssignHelp: Choose who in your team does it.
desk.openJobsHelp: Posted by clients. Apply, and the client chooses who does it.
desk.agreementsHelp: Jobs not agreed yet. Your team sees them only after the client agrees.
desk.noAgreements: None waiting. Write one after a call with a client.
desk.deadlinesHelp: Every job in progress, soonest first.
desk.moneyHelp: From jobs clients accepted. Demo: no real money.

team.membersHelp: Badges go up by themselves by the rules. Jobs in the last 30 days show how work is shared.
team.evidence: {{jobs}} verified jobs · {{streak}} in a row with no changes · changes asked {{back}} times
team.noMembers: No one yet. Open a spot below.
team.seatsHelp: Everyone with this skill is told when you open spots.
team.testTaskHelp: Optional. Same question for every applicant makes comparing fair.
team.clientsHelp: Invite a client from your network: they sign up with your code and are linked to your team.
team.inviteHow: The client opens Sajha Kaam, taps Create account, chooses Client and enters this code.
team.inviteMessage: Join my team {{team}} on Sajha Kaam to post your jobs. Sign up as a client with invite code {{code}}.

notes.title: My notes
notes.help: Your own review comments. When something is missing, the quick check quotes your closest note, so members hear your words. Every “ask for changes” note is added here.
notes.addEx: Buttons must be at least 44px tall on phones.

requests.title: Applying to join
requests.help: Shown without names, photos or districts. Look at the work.
requests.noSeats: No spots left. Open another spot first.
requests.blindNote: Mother tongues and districts are hidden until you decide, so choices are based on work.

junior.profileBody: Add skills, languages and a work sample.
junior.noTeamBody_one: {{count}} team has open spots for your skills.
junior.noTeamBody_other: {{count}} teams have open spots for your skills.
junior.noJobs: No jobs yet. Your Leader will assign one.
junior.openJobsHelp: As a ★★★★★ Mentor you can apply for jobs clients post. Your Leader still checks the work.
junior.earnedHeld: {{amount}} more when clients accept your work

teams.title: Find a team
teams.help: Teams with open spots in your skills. The Leader sees your work, not your name.
teams.empty: No open spots for your skills right now. You'll get a notification when one opens.
teams.noNameWarning: Use a link that doesn't show your name or face, so the Leader judges only the work.
teams.noteEx: What you've done and what you want to learn.
teams.addSkillFirst: Add this skill to your profile first.

logbook.title: Work Record
logbook.help: Each job here was approved by your Leader and accepted by the client, then verified. Anyone can check it with this link or QR code.

profile.title: My profile
profile.help: Like a Europass CV: the same sections for everyone.
profile.incomplete: Add at least one skill, one language and one work sample to ask to join teams.
profile.aboutHelp: Leaders see this only after accepting you.
profile.samplesHelp: Up to 3 links (GitHub, YouTube unlisted, Google Drive).
profile.hours: Hours per week you can work
profile.districtHelp: Private. Never shown to Leaders or clients.

client.title: My jobs
client.noAnchor: Not linked to a Leader yet: Leaders and Mentors with that skill can apply for your jobs.
client.readyHelp: Checked by the Leader. Accept it to add a verified job to the member's Work Record.
client.postBody: A short form, like a CV template.
client.toAgreeHelp: Agreements and changes from your Leader.
client.toChooseHelp: People applied for jobs you posted.

post.title: Post a job
post.help: Fill the template. A quick check tells you what's missing before you post.
post.titleEx: Make our menu page work on phones
post.doneHelp: Things you can check yes or no. They decide when the job is finished.
post.refsHelp: Add links to things you like, or don't, so nobody has to guess.
post.anyAnchor: Any Leader or Mentor with this skill
post.sendToHelp: Goes straight to your Leader's team.
post.anyAnchorHelp: Leaders and Mentors with this skill can apply; you choose one.
post.p_bad_link: An example link must start with https://
post.p_vague: “{{item}}” is hard to check ({{words}}). Make it measurable.
post.p_below: Budget is below the fair minimum of {{min}}.
post.notYourAnchor: You can only send jobs to a Leader you're linked with.
post.skillMismatch: That Leader's team does a different skill. Choose another skill or “Any Leader”.
post.deliverablesEx_design: 3 logo options as PNG and SVG

write.title: Write a job for a client
write.help: Fill the template after talking with your client. They read it and tap Agree. Your team sees nothing before that.
write.clientAsked: Your client asked for this change:
write.noClients: No clients yet. Invite one from the Team tab first.
write.alreadyAgreed: This is already agreed. Propose a change from the job page instead.

agree.notYet: Not agreed yet. Nobody starts work before both sides agree.
agree.changeWaiting: Waiting for {{client}} to accept your proposed change.
agree.proposeOpen: Propose a change to deadline or budget
agree.proposeHelp: The agreement stays as it is until the client accepts.
agree.whyEx: The client added a second page to the job.
agree.nothingChanged: Change the deadline or the budget first.
agree.belowMinimum: That budget is below the fair minimum for this skill.
agree.fromClientHelp: Agree if it's clear and fair. Or edit it: the client then agrees to your version.
agree.waitingJunior: Waiting for {{name}} to accept the offer.
agree.reviewHelp: {{name}} wrote this from your conversation. Read it below, then agree or ask for changes.
agree.agreeMeans: Once you agree it's locked. Later changes need your OK.
agree.changesEx: Please add a gluten-free section to the menu.
agree.changeHelp: {{name}} proposed this. Nothing changes unless you accept.
agree.declineChange: Keep the agreement as it is

brief.title: Your job offer
brief.help: {{name}} offered you this job. Read the offer, then accept it to start.
brief.readBelow: The full details are in the agreement below.

review.title: Check the work
review.sendBackHelp: The member sees this. It's also added to your notes for future checks.

apply.title: Apply for this job
apply.helpAnchor: The client chooses who does it. Applying means you agree to the agreement as written. If chosen, you give it to your team.
apply.helpMentor: As a ★★★★★ Mentor you can apply yourself. Applying means you accept the agreement as written. If chosen, you start straight away and {{name}} checks your work before the client sees it.
apply.noteEx: I've made two reels for shops like yours.
apply.waiting: You applied. Waiting for the client to choose.
apply.not_chosen: The client chose someone else this time.
apply.listHelp: Leaders and Mentors with this skill. Choose one: the job is then agreed.
apply.none: Nobody has applied yet. Leaders and Mentors with this skill can see your job.
apply.mentorChecked: A Mentor's work is still checked by their Team Leader before you see it.
apply.noLongerMentor: This person's badge changed, so they can't be chosen now.
apply.videoHelp: Up to 2 minutes: who you are and one piece of work you're proud of. Upload it to YouTube as “Unlisted” or to Google Drive shared with “anyone with the link”, then paste the link.
apply.videoNotSupported: Use a https link from YouTube, Google Drive, Vimeo or Loom.

pay.title: Pay for this job
pay.help: Held until you accept the work, then paid to the team like this.
pay.held: Paid {{amount}} · held until the client accepts the work
pay.payFirst: Pay first: accepting the work releases the payment to the team.
pay.alreadyPaid: The client has paid this budget, so only the deadline can change.
